translation:
Forget about that! The truth behind this
case—I've finally figured it out!
The… truth?
This!

Full of confidence, Haruhi presented the
poster made by the computer society.
And—what's this got to do with the truth?

I respond—deliberately trying to sound
forced.
You still don't understand?

That's why you'll always be a low-ranking
brigade member, Kyon.

Although I'm not particularly interested in this
inner brigade hierarchy anyways.

Seeing as you can't make it past the "D” of
"deductive reasoning,” I'll explain it from zero.

I'd be honored. So, what exactly did you
supposedly deduce and how?
Look at this.

While saying so, Haruhi pointed to the "H2O”
letters on the poster—
…Hmm?

Look reeeally closely—these letters look like
1-10 don't they?
Well, they don't not look like that…

In other words, those computer society guys
saw this and misunderstood the whole thing!
It seems Haruhi's caught on to this too.

If this had to be a scene from a detective
drama, it would be the eureka scene.

That's why there's all this fuss about class
1-10 when it doesn't even exist.

Though there were others making a fuss of it.
Look—there's even one right in front of me!
A flaaaawless deduction, if I do say so myself.

All this talk of "man-eating classrooms” and
whatnot got us worried about nothing.
I see. That's certainly possible.
Gotta remember to moderate my responses.

You listening? It's not just possible, that's
what actually happened! I'm sure of it!

As expected of Miss Suzumiya. In fact, I also
happened to hear something along these lines.

That after staying up all night, the club
members reached the limits of their fatigue…
That's it! [#W30That]'s exactly what I'm saying!

In a haze of drowsiness, they saw this poster
and misjudged it, making a huge fuss!

Haruhi confidently explained things—but in
reality, it's a far-fetched explanation.
For example—the location of the poster.

No matter how much it looks like 1-10, the
poster was at eye level.

How could you possibly mistake such a low
poster for the classroom plate?

So the man-eating classroom doesn't exist
after all, right?
Exactly, Mikuru.

My flawless reasoning has proved it
magnificently!

You have quite the nerve to call it flawless
reasoning.

But as far as I'm concerned—so long as
Haruhi's satisfied, that's good enough.
Well? The whole thing is settled now, right?

So the "man-eating classroom” was just the
result of the club members seeing things.

That's how it is. Well, even with an ending like
this, I still had a little bit of fun.
About Haruhi
